note: Medicine Bow NF, Pole Mountain unit, 1 mi off Happy Jack Rd (WY-210) about 10 mi E of Laramie (I-80 exit 323), on the Tie City / Happy Jack trail network. One loop, some sites in aspen-fir-spruce and some in a grassy meadow; the interior road is narrow and rough in places. --Claude
